Alaska

March 6–12, 2016

Overview — Daily Itinerary — Places to Stay — Vlogs

Overview

A spring break trip to Alaska. We watched the northern lights in Fairbanks and visited Denali National Park. We then flew to Barrow, the northernmost city in North America.
